mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases (Pearson r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with subsequent PAYEMS increases (Pearson r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous two months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with subsequent negative SPX returns (Pearson r > -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the historical average by more than 1%, it signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increases do not correlate with subsequent negative SPX returns (Pearson r > -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) and an increase in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a shift from investment to consumption, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in multivariate regression).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in multivariate regression).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the previous quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decreases do not correlate with subsequent negative SPX returns (Pearson r > -0.2).
